page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c8g1.2xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. The compute subsystem is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing 8 virtual CPUs across 4 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. It includes 31.0 GB of system memory, yielding 3.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU with 16 GB of dedicated video memory. Local storage is not included, requiring reliance on external block storage, and baseline network throughput is rated at 5 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a clear distinction between the compute processor and the GPU coprocessor. General-purpose CPU testing displays modest throughput, with a Geekbench single-core score of 935.0 and multi-core score of 3617.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 7041.46. Similarly, synthetic memory tests reflect middle-tier bandwidth, clocking 39.4 GB/sec for uncached reads and 36.26 GB/sec for uncached writes. These metrics place general integer, compression, and static web serving capabilities in lower tiers relative to contemporary general-purpose cloud hardware.

In contrast, the integrated NVIDIA T4 accelerator delivers competitive processing throughput for artificial intelligence workloads. LLM inference benchmarks record 8407.18 tokens per second on prompt processing for a 135M parameter model and 1134.43 tokens per second for a 7B parameter model, both reaching top-tier percentiles. Text generation for the 7B model reaches 33.96 tokens per second. Consequently, this server instance provides cost efficiency for GPU-bound inference, video transcoding, and light machine learning pipelines where high-end CPU performance and local scratch disks are not prerequisites.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c8g1.2xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated instance configured with 8 vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, 31.0 GB of RAM, and a single NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU equipped with 16 GB of VRAM. It operates on the KVM hypervisor with 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and includes no local disk storage. While baseline host processor benchmarks fall into lower percentiles with a Geekbench single-core score of 935.0 and multi-core score of 3617.0, the hardware coprocessor excels in machine learning execution. In inference evaluations, the server achieves top-tier prompt processing speeds of 1134.43 tokens per second on 7B models. This hardware profile suits deep learning inference, image processing, and distributed GPU compute tasks that do not demand high host-side CPU throughput.
